artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Burton Tremaine
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of an elderly man seated, facing forward with his head turned slightly to the right. He has a broad forehead, deep-set eyes, a small mustache, and a beard. His hair is covered by a flat cap. He is dressed in a formal jacket, shirt, and bow tie, with bold lines outlining his profile. The sketch is monochrome with shading for depth, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Les Champs-Elysées
artworks.medium: color lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Burton Tremaine

artworks.title: Queen of Hearts (Herzdame)
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Burton Tremaine
artworks.description: The image displays intersecting lines and swirling curves creating an abstract composition. A central spiral resembles a stylized treble clef. Other lines intersect diagonally and horizontally, forming geometric shapes. Small leaf-like forms are present, evoking imagery of plants or organic growth. The overall effect is a blend of geometric precision and free-form, meandering lines, resembling a musical composition visually.

artworks.title: Cheval aile (Winged Horse)
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Burton Tremaine
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse. The artwork shows a sketch-like image of a horse with an elongated neck and flowing mane. The horse is depicted with expressive lines that convey movement, and black shading adds contrast and depth. The background has a gradient from dark to light, emphasizing the dynamic pose and form of the horse within an abstract space. The overall composition is energetic and fluid.

artworks.title: Paul Cezanne
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Burton Tremaine
artworks.description: The image depicts a frontal drawing of a person with a slightly left inclination. The person has facial hair, a calm expression, visible eyes, and a high forehead. The hair is curly and sparse on top. They wear a dark, textured jacket that merges into a plain, light-colored background. There is no visible jewelry or objects held.

artworks.title: Evening (Le soir)
artworks.medium: 5-color lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Burton Tremaine
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with a view from an elevated point overlooking a harbor scene. The horizon is in the upper third, with distant ships under sails. A large pier or structure is on the right, textured with pointillist brushstrokes. The color palette includes pastel shades of pinks, blues, and yellows, capturing light on the water and sky. Small sailboats with colorful sails are close by, reflecting warm tones onto the water. The sea beyond is in cooler blues and greens. The brushstroke technique is characterized by small, systematic dots of color blending optically from afar. The scene conveys a harmonious balance of movement and light.

artworks.title: Game of Checkers (La partie de dames)
artworks.medium: color lithograph on China paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Burton Tremaine
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals and one person standing. All have their upper bodies visible. The person on the left is seated, facing the table, with a beard and short hair. The person on the right is also seated, leaned forward towards the table, showing a side profile and short hair. The standing person is leaning over the table, with one hand on their chin and hair up in a bun. Their facial expressions are not clearly defined. Both seated individuals wear dark, blended garments, while the standing person wears a patterned dress. The table has a checkerboard pattern. The room has a wall with ornate, floral wallpaper in the background.

artworks.title: Motherhood (Maternite)
artworks.medium: color lithograph on Japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Burton Tremaine
artworks.description: The image shows a round table with a textured cloth, a person holding a small child beside it under a shaded light. The color palette includes deep blues, browns, and muted creams with hints of red on the tablecloth. The person and child are seated to the right, partially in shadow, in a dimly lit room. Brown chairs are visible in the background against the walls, framing the scene.

artworks.title: River Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a horizon in the upper third, marked by mountains. In the distance, a bridge crosses a body of water. Loose brushstrokes convey a spontaneous feel. Earthy tones dominate the color palette, giving an antique quality. A tree trunk and two figures are also present in the scene.

artworks.title: A Young and an Old Bacchant
artworks.artist: Marcantonio Raimondi, after Raphael or Giulio Romano
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting two mythological figures alongside a tree and a pedestal with sculpted heads. The figures are shown embracing, with the central figure supporting the other as they walk. The central figure has a beard and carries a cloak, while the younger figure holds a vine with grape clusters. A tree and a pedestal with sculpted heads are included, along with a barrel on the ground. The artwork has a classical aesthetic reminiscent of Renaissance art.

artworks.title: Massacre of the Innocents
artworks.medium: pen and brown and gray ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper with scraping, incised throughout, the verso blackened for transfer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic scene within an architecturally-rich environment. The drawing shows entangled forms suggesting movement and struggle, set amidst classical architecture with columns and ruins. Figures in dynamic gestures are depicted in the detailed scene, set against a cityscape extending to rolling hills. The architectural features resemble ancient Roman or Greek styles, including ruins and a triumphal arch, highlighting a historical context. The drawing captures a dramatic moment of unrest.

artworks.title: A Landscape with Seated Soldiers and Fishermen
artworks.medium: black chalk with watercolor and white heightening on brown washed laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a pastoral landscape with people engaging in leisure activities near a body of water. There is an elaborate stone structure with a relief, partially covered by a tree. In the distance, sailboats can be seen on the water. The brushstrokes are delicate, creating a tranquil ambiance. The color palette is soft and earthy, with browns, greens, and white accents. The scene conveys a serene afternoon by the shore.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Wooded Ravine
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray wash heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky woodland setting with trees, rocks, and foliage. The viewpoint appears to be from a lower vantage point looking upwards. The landscape is filled with trees and rocks blending with the sky, depicted through fine brushstrokes creating light and shadow. The color palette consists of earthy browns and grays. The scene includes weathered rocks in the foreground and complex, layered foliage in the background.

artworks.title: Allegory of Minerva as the Head of the Muses
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black  chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with mythological figures. A central nude female figure holds a staff or spear, partially draped in a flowing garment. Other figures in flowing robes surround her, some sitting and others in conversation. Above them on clouds sit two regal figures holding symbols of power, with a cherub-like figure on a chariot drawn by swans. Subtle architectural elements in the background contribute to a classical atmosphere. The drawing features detailed line work emphasizing movement and expressions.

artworks.title: Harpocrates
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of classical-style figures in a dynamic scene. The figures are arranged in a harmonious manner, interacting with one another in various expressive poses. The drawing is executed in red chalk, giving it a soft and warm appearance.

artworks.title: A Man Seen from Behind [recto]
artworks.medium: red chalk heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing the full body of a person from behind. The person appears to be in a slightly twisting position, with their upper body turned to the right and their lower body facing forward. Their head is turned to the left, with hair that seems to be wrapped or styled upward. The person appears to be draped in cloth that wraps around their torso and lower body, which is depicted with smooth, flowing lines suggesting folds and depth. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects being held. The background of the image is simple and plain, with no additional elements. The drawing is rendered on a textured paper.

artworks.title: A Man Seen from Behind [verso]
artworks.medium: red chalk and pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length figure of a nude person standing with their back to the viewer, captured from an upward angle looking towards the right side of their body. The person's head is turned slightly to the left, giving a partial profile view of their facial features, which are minimally detailed, and they have a bald head. The individual is depicted in a classical pose, with one arm placed across the midsection and the other arm draped along the side. There are no clothing or objects depicted on or around the person, with the focus on the contours and muscles of the figure. The background is a plain, textured surface without any additional objects or scenery, and the drawing style is characterized by flowing lines and a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: Head of Saint Francis
artworks.medium: black, red and white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person's upper body in a side profile view. The person's head is slightly tilted upwards, with detailed facial features including pronounced cheekbones and a strong jawline. The person has short, neat hair and what appears to be the start of a beard or facial hair. The drawing does not depict any clothing color variations but appears to show a collar. The person is not wearing any jewelry or holding any objects. The background is plain and unembellished.

artworks.title: The Heart of the Andes
artworks.medium: watercolor on joined sheets of wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: This painting shows a landscape view from an elevated position. Reddish-brown and dark green trees and plants surround a waterfall at the bottom of the painting, with white water cascading into a reflective pool. Beyond, a dense forest leads to rolling hills and tall, reddish-brown mountains. There are more mountains on the left, although these are white. In the center, there are distant shapes in the forest that may be buildings. Near the bottom left, a small ridge overlooks the waterfall, with a small white cross standing upright on it. The blue sky above is filled with swirling gray clouds that seem to touch the top of the mountains on the right. The color palette is warm, dominated by browns and greens, with the blue sky in the upper left.

artworks.title: Young Woman Dressing Herself
artworks.medium: pastel over charcoal on tan wove(?) paper mounted on board
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the W. Averell Harriman Foundation in memory of Marie N. Harriman
artworks.description: This drawing shows a woman seen from the back, standing with her head bent forward. She appears to be lifting a white skirt or dress over her head, and her shoulders and neck are covered by white fabric. She is otherwise nude. Her head is entirely obscured except for a sliver of dark hair, and she has pale skin. She stands on a pile of blue and white fabric. The background features green foliage, including grass and a brown tree trunk in the top right corner. The visible lines of the drawing provide some texture.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink on laid paper
artworks.description: Six men and women stand or kneel in front of a sixth person, a man, holding the limp corpse of another, Jesus, in this vertical drawing on cream-white paper. Jesus and the man supporting him are in the lower right corner of the page, and a woman with long, loose hair bends low to kiss Jesus’s feet in the lower left corner. These three people are the mostly simply drawn of the group, sketched in with outlines and contours without shading. The other woman kneels with her hands together, facing Jesus in profile. A young, cleanshaven man stands at her far side and rests his hand on her other shoulder. A trio of three men stand closely behind this pair. All three wear elaborate hats, two may converse, and one holds a drum-like object and another a hammer. A rectangular stone tomb stretches behind Jesus at the foot of a rocky cliff face. Across the paper, three crosses rise from a hill in the top left corner of the composition. A ladder leans against the central cross, and men hang heavily from the other two. The artist signed and dated the work as if he had inscribed the top middle of the tomb cover. A capital letter D is tucked between the wide legs of a capital A, both under the date, 1504.

artworks.title: Saint Sebastian
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythical creature in a forest setting. The drawing depicts a horned, humanoid figure standing in front of a large, ancient tree. The figure is adorned with a necklace and has an elaborate hairstyle with possible floral elements intertwined. It is covered with a draped cloth around its waist and appears to be holding objects or gestures in its hands. In the foreground, a goat or similar horned creature is also present. The background is filled with stylized trees, creating a sense of depth and wilderness. The drawing is highly detailed with fine lines and emphasizes texture and intricate forms of foliage and bark.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Saint John
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink heightened with white on blue prepared paper
artworks.description: Two individuals are depicted from head to toe, standing close together. The individual in front has an aged facial appearance, with a distinct profile, wearing a hooded garment. Their hands are visible, with one hand raised in a gesture. The person behind has curly hair and draped clothing. Both are shown in detailed line work, with intricate texture on their clothing. The background is plain and muted, emphasizing the figures.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man Standing
artworks.medium: black and red chalk with charcoal on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 52.6 x 35 cm (20 11/16 x 13 3/4 in.)
support: 55.3 x 35 cm (21 3/4 x 13 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a man posed from head to just above his knees. He is standing with his left leg slightly bent, holding a hat in his left hand and his cloak in his right hand. The man has distinct facial features including a prominent chin, slightly arched eyebrows, and a composed expression. His short hair is receding at the front and appears to be brushed back. He is dressed in a large, ruffled collar, a long-sleeved garment, and a cloak over his shoulders. The background is plain, emphasizing the man's portrait.
